Why are there two bosses?!|audio = VoidcoreWave35-2.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 35 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Brute''' is a mini-boss that appears in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has high health but rather slow speed. The '''Void Brute''' has one ability, where it will pick up a boulder from the ground and throw it at a tower or unit in its range of 25. Upon impact, the boulder will split into multiple smaller boulders, which apply the same effects as it does. Any tower hit receives a 40% [[Fatigue Debuff]] (22.22% increase) while units receive 100 damage. When performing this ability, the [[Shield Health]] of the '''Void Brute''' is set to 6,000. While this [[Shield Health]] exists, the '''Void Brute''' becomes an [[Aggro]] enemy and stays this way until all the [[Shield Health]] is depleted. As it just changes the [[Shield Health]] rather than adding it, this means that if this ability is used while the [[Shield Health]] from the previous ability usage has not been fully depleted, it will not add 6,000 [[Shield Health]] on top of the currently existing [[Shield Health]], but instead just changes it back to 6,000 again. ==Logbook Description== "''Void Brutes are the strongest fighters of bloomed realms, fallen victim to the whispers of the Void. The power held within the gems strengthened their bodies and gradually began consuming them, solidifying into a singular giant mass that they use as a weapon. They are naturally a bit dumb, and spend most of their time laying in a field of flowers as their bodies slowly turn into stone and gem.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Brute''' is a creature with white skin. The left side of its body has been fully corrupted, turning its skin black there, also giving it purple veins, purple crystals, flowers and purple. In its torso, it has a giant hole. It wears beige cloth around its waist. It has a white head with part of it missing, being filled in with a mixture of small white and black pieces. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as the [[Engineer]], [[Kingpin]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Juggernaut]] are required to deal with the '''Void Brute'''. **The [[Commander]] can be a good support option to dealing with the '''Void Brute's''' [[Aggro]] target and [[Shield Health]]. *Dealing with the other enemies will make the '''Void Brute's''' ''Bound Crush'' ability less threatening. *In [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, it is recommended to deal as much damage to the '''Void Brute''' as possible before Wave 35 starts, as the '''Void Brute''' and [[Void Keeper]] together can be quite threatening. *The '''Void Brute''' can often reach far enough to leave the range of towers. If using the [[DJ Booth]], it is recommended to switch to the Purple track once it leaves the range of towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HardcoreReworkPI3.png|'''Void Brute''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidBruteCA.png|'''Void Brute''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} DefeatVoidBruteBadge.png|'''Void Brute''' on its badge. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidBruteIconIG.png|'''Void Brute''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Brute's''' name, appearance and ability are based on the [[Brute]] enemy. **The ''Bound Crush'' ability resembles the ''Rock Throw'' ability from the [[Brute (The Heights)|Brute]] from the [[SFOTH Event]] and [[Tank]]'s first and second version. **Ironically, '''Void Brute''' has fewer abilities than [[Brute]]. *The '''Void Brute's''' concept art has the '''Void Brute''' wear chains on its left arm while also having an eye on its face, though these details are not present in-game. *The '''Void Brute''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. == Update History == *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Brute''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health increased from 75,000 to 80,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. **''Bound Crush'' starting ability cooldown increased from 17.5 to 24. ==Notes== {{Hardcore|[[Elite Mystery]]|Wave 32|Void Brute|Wave 33|[[Unknown Small]] & [[Elite Void Rusher]]|Wave 34}} {{Voidcore|[[Elite Mystery]]|Wave 33|Void Brute|Wave 34|[[Void Keeper]]|Wave 35}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
